lore: (Son Goku (孫そん悟ご空くう Son Gokū), born Kakarot (カカロット Kakarotto), is a Saiyan raised on Earth. she is the second born, as well as youngest child of Bardock and Gine. Originally sent to Earth by his parents as an infant, Kakarot was adopted by Grandpa Gohan and renamed Son Goku. A head injury at an early age altered Goku's memory, ridding her of her initial destructive nature and allowing her to grow up to become one of Earth's greatest defenders. Goku constantly strives and trains to be the greatest warrior possible, which has kept the Earth and the universe safe from destruction multiple times.)

Kaioken is a technique that multiplies ki, speed and power and Goku demonstrates the ability to heighten the effect of the Kaioken to increasingly higher multiplications from x2 to as high as x100." + "In her Super Saiyan form Goku's hair rises on end and turns golden blond, her skin considerably lightens, her aura becomes fire like, and her eyes become a turquoise green." + "Goku's hair is slightly longer and further on end in this form and his body now gives off lightning-like electric discharges from his increased power" + "When Goku uses the form, she is near identical to her Super Saiyan state only that the hair and irises are light blue in color and are slightly bigger; the overall body structure is thinner and somewhat taller, similar to Super Saiyan God. and boasts a vibrant, fiery, electric blue aura" + "When fully synchronizing her defensive impulse with her natural drive for combat, Goku finally comes into the full power of Ultra Instinct and her full potential this results in him fully transforming by gaining silver hair and gaining a more ethereal skin tone.")

lore: ("Vegeta (ベジータ Bejīta), more specifically Vegeta IV (ベジータ四世 Bejīta Yonsei), recognized as princess Vegeta (ベジータ王子 Bejīta Ōji), is the princess of the fallen Saiyan race. Regal, egotistical, and full of pride, Vegeta was once a ruthless, cold-blooded warrior and outright killer, but later abandoned her position in the Frieza Force for a peaceful life on Earth. she would repeatedly fight alongside earths most powerful warriors in order to protect Earth and her friends, as well as to surpass Goku in power")

transformations: ("When she transforms into a Super Saiyan, Vegeta's hair turns pale blond, her eyes become green, and her body becomes slightly more muscular" + "vegetas hair is slightly longer and further on end in this form and his body now gives off lightning-like electric discharges from his increased power" + "ultra Ego resembles Super Saiyan 3.[8] The user's eyebrows become ridge-like, with no visible facial hair. The user's hair become tyrian purple in color. Their eyes attain a magenta-like color irises as well and also retain visible black pupils. Additionally the user's muscle mass seems to gain a small increase and become much more defined. The user also gains flaming-like purple aura that circulate around their body. When the Ultra Ego transformation is in use, the user becomes exponentially more powerful than before and gains the ability to use Power of Destruction in full. The user's aura can also be manifested in an opaque, flame-like state which can destroy enemy attacks on contact. Vegeta names the technique Ultra Ego in contrast to Ultra Instinct, which draws upon the principles of conquering oneself, while Ultra Ego seems to draw upon a severe level of self-indulgence in battle".
